title: JukeboxPlayer
description: Mod that adds a feature to play songs in the game
body:
# What is this?
A **simple** in-game music streaming mod that allows players to listen to audio directly inside Minecraft.

![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9c076484887af9d775bbab7c36f35fa3c185030.png)

This mod works on **both client and server**, enabling a seamless experience in singleplayer and multiplayer environments. Players can stream music from external sources or play audio from local files, creating a more immersive and customizable gameplay atmosphere.

---

# How to use?
Press **F9** to open the GUI.

---

# Features
- Stream audio from online sources
- Play music from local files
- Optional downloading for offline playback
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
- Lightweight and easy to use
- Supports client-server interaction

---

# Notes
- This mod requires an internet connection for streaming features
- Users are responsible for the content they access or download
- Make sure you have the rights to use any audio content
- On first use, the mod may automatically download external dependencies such as **FFmpeg** and **yt-dlp** to enable audio streaming functionality
- Some streaming sources may not work in certain regions or may depend on third-party services

---

# Multiplayer Support
This mod supports multiplayer environments. Audio playback and streaming features can work across client-server setups depending on server configuration.

---

# Disclaimer
This project is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, FFmpeg, or yt-dlp.  
Users are responsible for complying with the terms of service and copyright laws related to the content they stream or download.
